method: Batch 42. Same double and row layout as fireballs-b41-reference.json (rows keep the ghast target index in slot 9 of an entity: the player index or -1), with `unified: true` records walking ONE list in insertion order as World.updateEntities does (a ball launched before a mob joined updates before it; a ball launched in the pass updates in it; the mobs that tick are those of `types` not named by a `join` or `idle` op), plus the ops `join k`, `idle k`, `health k h` and `snow v i` (a snowball of thrower i lands on entity v through zj.a(MovingObjectPosition), hurts row [v, damaged, health]).
